mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the unemployment rate above 8% for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 8.0 for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 3% signals deteriorating demand, which reduces corporate earnings and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when GDPC1 falls > 3% over 6 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary stance, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 0.5% signals labor market tightening, which raises wage pressures and inflation expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS growth > 0.5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) below 500K units signals weakening residential investment, which reduces GDP growth and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when HOUST < 500 for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) below 97 signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings and economic growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when INDPRO < 97 for 6 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in the unemployment rate decline below 6% signals labor market tightening, which raises wage pressures and inflation expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when UNRATE falls below 6% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).
